title: XP summary v2
description: The progression of one bot binding, derived on every read from its XP ledgers and never stored. totalXp is the net of the bot's xp-policy-1 entries (award, correction and reinstatement for accepted work, kept as history) and its xp-policy-2 task awards, so it is never negative. level is the position of totalXp in the versioned level table named by levelTableVersion: levelFloorXp is the cumulative XP at which that level starts and nextLevelXp is the floor of the next level, or null at the last level. acceptedWorkCount is the number of legacy WorkItems for which the bot's net xp-policy-1 XP is above zero, unchanged from v1. creditedTaskCount is the number of tasks credited to the bot. XP is credited automatically, once per task, when a task ends cleanly (no pending approval or question at its end, no collection gap over it, a known terminal state). It reflects observed activity, not verified outcomes, and not model ability or current condition. Tokens, tool calls, retries and generation jobs never earn it. Nothing here is a health value, score or ranking. A bot with no entries reads totalXp 0 at level 1. policyVersion names the policy that credits new XP. The bot is referenced only by the opaque bindingId of the bot-binding contract.
